articles.title: 'Everyone is chipping in to make this happen': Toronto charity building micro-shelter village in Scarborough
articles.summary: Tiny Tiny Homes, a Toronto charity that builds mobile and emergency shelters to those experiencing homelessness, is building a micro-shelter village in Scarborough that will provide transitional housing to 10 people by the end of this year.

articles.summary: Toronto police say a search is ongoing for a 63-year-old woman named Ann, who was last seen over the weekend in the city’s east end. articles.title: YouTube sensation Ms. Rachel announces debut album with Mr. Aron, ‘I’m So Happy’
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Parents of toddlers everywhere, prepare yourselves. YouTube sensation and music teacher Ms. Rachel and her husband, Aron Accurso, will release their debut album, the 23-track “I'm So Happy,” on Sept. 25.

articles.summary: A motorcyclist was rushed to a hospital on Monday evening following a serious crash that happened in Brampton. articles.summary: A 37-year-old man from Vaughan is facing several charges in connection to a months-long drug trafficking investigation.  York Regional Police say the investigation started in February after officers became aware of a suspect who was believed to be trafficking controlled substances in Vaughan and nearby areas. articles.title: Markham hosts the IndyCar race for the 1st time. Here's what to expect
articles.summary: The City of Markham is hosting the IndyCar race for the first time this weekend. CBC’s Greg Ross gives you a first look at what to expect.

articles.title: Ontario to restore Brampton's Heart Lake Conservation Park at price tag of $1.2M
articles.summary: The provincial government announced Monday it will be taking on a restoration project at the Heart Lake Conservation Park in Brampton, Ont.

articles.title: Citing overcrowding, Mississauga animal services runs $25 adoption blitz
articles.summary: In an effort to ease overcrowding, Mississauga Animal Services Shelter says it's running a $25 dog and cat adoption blitz until the end of August.

articles.title: Toronto Liberal MP Shaun Chen to resign following car accident last year
articles.summary: Liberal MP Shaun Chen says he plans to resign at the end of this week. The Scarborough North MP issued a statement on social media saying injuries sustained in a car accident in late 2025 have prevented him from travelling to Ottawa as often as the job requires.

articles.title: SIU investigating Pickering, Ont., crash involving police cruiser, civilian vehicle
articles.summary: The province's police watchdog is investigating after a police cruiser and a civilian vehicle crashed in Pickering, Ont., Friday.

articles.title: 3rd man arrested in Toronto synagogue shooting investigation: York police
articles.summary: A Barrie man has been arrested as part of an investigation into synagogues being shot at in Vaughan and Toronto earlier this year, police say.

articles.title: Police say Oshawa hit-and-run was intentional, suspect arrested
articles.summary: An Oshawa man faces several charges after police say he intentionally struck another person with his car last week.

articles.title: Changes to Portland Street intersection driving cycling, pedestrian activity, data shows
articles.summary: After making big changes to how motor vehicles can use the downtown intersection of Wellington Street W. and Portland Street, the City of Toronto says early data shows motor vehicle trips are significantly down while cycling and walking are up in the area.

articles.title: 2 men arrested after armed robbery, fleeing from officers in stolen vehicle: Toronto police
articles.summary: Toronto police say two men have been arrested in connection with an armed robbery investigation in the city's downtown core.

articles.title: Toronto dogs, owners come out to play at Doggie Fest in Roundhouse Park
articles.summary: Toronto dogs and their owners came out to Doggie Fest at Roundhouse Park Sunday for a variety of attractions, treats and picture opportunities.
